budget_items.what_was_recorded: The FY21 budget was 65% expended in April, the tenth month of the fiscal year, and the director said it is on track.
budget_items.quote: for the fy21 budget, april is the 10th month of the fiscal year. the budget is 65% expended.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A large electric bill came in the past month; the director said there are no major issues and the budget is on track.
budget_items.quote: we had a large electric bill the past month but there are no major issues and the budget is on track.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Library materials costs are lower until spring, when some annual renewals come up.
budget_items.quote: the costs for library materials are lower until the springtime when some annual renewals will come up.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The May 1st annual town meeting will finalize the FY22 budget, and the preliminary town budget is almost exactly what the library requested.
budget_items.quote: the may 1st annual town meeting will finalize the fy22 budget. the preliminary town budget is almost exactly what we requested.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The programming budget was 13% expended; the director said staff were finalizing program plans so the budget would be used.
The paper cutter was replaced; it is needed for craft preparation and saves costs in getting crafts together.
budget_items.quote: we replaced the paper cutter. it's needed for the craft preparation and saves costs in getting crafts together.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Poetry month programs are funded by the Mary Ellen and Richard Letarte Poetry fund.
budget_items.quote: programs are funded by the mary ellen and richard letarte poetry fund.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Bids for the carpet replacement will be opened on May 4th.
budget_items.quote: on may 4th we will have the bids for the carpet replacement.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Friends reported March book sales of around $400 and are thinning stock before accepting donations.
budget_items.quote: in their latest meeting the friends discussed book sales. march sales were around $400.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: LCC grants will move forward; the board had been operating below quorum.
budget_items.quote: muir noted that the lcc (lunenburg cultural council) grants will be moving forward.

topics.quote: harry made a motion to accept minutes of march 25th 2021 as amended, seconded by kate. the motion passed unanimously.
the may 1st annual town meeting will finalize the fy22 budget. the preliminary town budget is almost exactly what we requested.
the subcommittee met on wednesday and finalized the survey, which is the last major part of the strategic plan.
we covered chapter two: bylaws. our town charter takes the place of bylaws and this covers most of the responsibilities listed in the trustee handbook.
in their latest meeting the friends discussed book sales.
the bos did not meet on april 6th in person. all town boards are still meeting remotely.
